sources.title: Approved procedure requiring two approvals (text/version not supplied)
Urgent case in which both required approvals were skipped
sources.version: single incident, no case export supplied

decisions.question: One urgent case skipped both required approvals. Should the procedure define a bounded expedited/emergency path for urgent cases (still requiring approval, e.g. faster or single-approver-with-ratification), or should the two-approval requirement remain absolute with no exception path? The workaround itself must not become the default process without this decision.
decisions.owner: Owner of the approval policy (not identified in the request)
